segments.he: וְאֵין מְזַמְּנִין עַל הַמָּזוֹן בַּשֵּׁם פָּחוֹת מֵעֲשָׂרָה (וְכוּ׳). כֵּיוָן דְּבָעֵי לְמֵימַר ״נְבָרֵךְ לֵאלֹהֵינוּ״ — בְּצִיר מֵעֲשָׂרָה לָאו אוֹרַח אַרְעָא.
segments.en: We learned further in the mishna: «And one does not invite» others to recite Grace after Meals, i.e., conduct a zimmun, in order to thank God «for» one’s «nourishment, with the name» of God, «with fewer than ten» men present. «Since one is required to say: Let us bless our Lord,» in the presence of «fewer than ten» it is «not proper conduct» to mention the name of God.
